title: Compare identity and account
Coteja identidad y cuenta
核对身份与收款账户
Đối chiếu danh tính và tài khoản
summary: Submit authorized CURP and CLABE for one identity and beneficiary-account comparison, with a bound quote.
Envía CURP y CLABE autorizadas para un cotejo de identidad y cuenta beneficiaria con cotización vinculada.
按绑定报价提交已获授权的 CURP 与 CLABE，完成一次身份与收款账户核对。
Gửi CURP và CLABE được phép để đối chiếu danh tính với tài khoản thụ hưởng theo báo giá ràng buộc.
inputs: Authorized CURP and CLABE, current quote, required evidence and consents, stable request UUID.
output: Verification grade, task status, evidence and charges. Supported grades and required actions follow the live quote.
boundary: No unconditional approval or arbitrary person lookup. No direct bank-CURP identifier claim, unsupported card input or transfer without the quote's explicit authorization.
topics: Separate a name mismatch from missing evidence in CURP and CLABE onboarding
Read the verification grade before deciding a beneficiary change
audience: Mexico business onboarding and beneficiary management developers
